changes.title: SDD review assistant for large AI-generated changes

defects.summary: No error code or behaviour when git is missing, older than 2.34, or refuses the repository (C001-ADR-004)
defects.resolution: ERR-INTAKE-008 and C001-IF-012 §6 (five causes: not found, cannot start, no readable version, older than 2.34, repository refused); C001-REQ-125

defects.summary: Node.js 22+ and git 2.34+ are not stated as prerequisites (C001-ADR-001, C001-ADR-004)
defects.resolution: C001-CON-18 names Node.js 22+ and git 2.34+ (separate program, ADR-004 hardening) as prerequisites

defects.summary: Parser grammar versions are not named as a fixed-per-release input (C001-ADR-003)
defects.resolution: C001-CON-17 fixes parser grammar versions per release, citing C001-ADR-003

defects.summary: Evidence commands inherit the environment unchanged, so GIT_DIR and GIT_INDEX_FILE from a git-hook launch can point evidence runs at the developer's repository (C001-ADR-006)
defects.resolution: C001-IF-013 §1 item 7 removes git repository-locating environment variables from evidence commands; C001-REQ-525

defects.summary: Credential-store service names in the review configuration are not limited to the sdd-review namespace (C001-ADR-008)
defects.resolution: keyCredential.service pattern ^sdd-review(/.*)?$ in the IF-004 schema, ERR-CFG-004; C001-REQ-820

defects.summary: No error code or behaviour when a submodule commit recorded by the snapshot is missing locally (C001-ADR-006)
defects.resolution: C001-IF-013 §2 item 8 and G-16: missing submodule commit leaves an empty directory with notice ERR-EVID-012 (three causes); C001-REQ-526

defects.summary: Clean filters are forbidden (IF-012 §2 item 2), so files under a clean filter such as Git LFS always show as changed; behaviour and notice unspecified (C001-ADR-004)
defects.resolution: C001-IF-012 §7–§8 per Q-cleanfilter-01/02, Q-filterworkspace-01, Q-nonlfs-01: Git LFS verified by pointer hash, other filters by hardened stat rule, ERR-INTAKE-009 and ERR-EVID-013; C001-REQ-126…128, 527…529

defects.summary: Hardening profile core.fsmonitor=false (decision item 3, A1.3) does not disable fsmonitor on git 2.34: in v2.34.0 config.c and fsmonitor.c any non-empty value is a hook command run through the shell (here the program named false), booleans exist only in later releases; core.fsmonitor= with an empty value disables it on 2.34 and on 2.56.1 (source-confirmed 2026-11-20, empirical proof pending in C001-T-005)

Section 2 says coverage.py uses the sys.monitoring core on CPython 3.12 and later, but coverage.py CHANGES 7.11.1 and 7.15.3 state the sysmon core is incompatible with dynamic contexts (per-test contexts are dropped or refused), so the per-test adapter must force the ctrace core (COVERAGE_CORE=ctrace) on every Python version

Design 3 names dbus-next (MIT) for the Secret Service client but dbus-next 0.10.2 was last released 2021-10 and its tree (usocket, node-gyp 7, request) carries critical npm audit advisories (request, form-data, tar), so it violates NFR-D-02 and is not added; dbus-native 0.16.3 (MIT, maintained, 0 advisories) is the candidate for C001-T-0xx to pin

Vite is MIT as stated, but Vite 8.3.8 has lightningcss 1.33.0 (MPL-2.0, weak copyleft) as a regular dependency, which conflicts with NFR-D-03 and the forbidden copyleft list; Vite 7.3.8 with plugin-react 5.2.0 has no non-permissive dependency and 0 advisories; goes to P-01 before any task adds Vite

Section 3 gives Stryker.NET mutate filters with line spans, but the Stryker.NET documentation defines the span in the mutate option as character indices {first..last} of the file text, so the adapter must convert executed line ranges to character offsets

Section 2 says the Microsoft coverage engines have licences not permissive as far as known, but the NuGet metadata of Microsoft.CodeCoverage 18.12.0 declares MIT; no effect on the choice of AltCover (rejected for per-test attribution), only the stated reason is inaccurate

TS-166 says git's first error line names futureformat, but git 2.34.0 to 2.56.1 print 'fatal: unknown repository extension found:' on line 1 and the name on an indented line 2; T-005 takes the first line with its indented continuation lines
